note: Must-cover externally-verifiable claims a fact-checker must address in F03. A gold claim is 'covered' by an assertion when the assertion text matches every group in `all` (each group = alternatives, OR within group). Immutable once sealed; revise only via a new version + explicit decision, never silently to fit results.
